requirements.quote:
Servers SHOULD provide mitigations for this attack by limiting the
   usage and lifetime of address validation tokens; see Section 8.1.3.
requirements.condition: When a server issues or accepts address validation tokens.
requirements.required_behavior: The server should mitigate amplification attacks by limiting both the usage and lifetime of address validation tokens.
requirements.why_checkable: An implementation can be inspected or tested to verify that address validation tokens have enforced usage restrictions and finite lifetimes.
